//go:build js && wasm

package client

// OfflineRecoveryObservation returns one value copy. It performs no JS work,
// accepts no revision input, and never changes authority or confirmed state.
func OfflineRecoveryObservation() OfflineRecoveryDiagnostic {
	offlineAuthorityMu.Lock()
	var snapshot OfflineRecoveryDiagnostic
	if documentOffline != nil { snapshot = documentOffline.diag }
	offlineAuthorityMu.Unlock()
	return snapshot.sanitized()
}

type OfflineDiagnosticMethod uint8
const (
	OfflineDiagnosticMethodUpdate OfflineDiagnosticMethod = iota + 1
	OfflineDiagnosticMethodUnregister
	OfflineDiagnosticMethodRegister
)
type OfflineDiagnosticRPC uint8
const (
	OfflineDiagnosticRPCStatus OfflineDiagnosticRPC = iota + 1
	OfflineDiagnosticRPCDisableRecovered
)
type OfflineDiagnosticRPCEvent uint8
const (
	OfflineDiagnosticChannelCreated OfflineDiagnosticRPCEvent = iota + 1
	OfflineDiagnosticListenerAdded
	OfflineDiagnosticListenerRemoved
	OfflineDiagnosticPortStarted
	OfflineDiagnosticPort1Closed
	OfflineDiagnosticPort2Closed
	OfflineDiagnosticTrustedEvent
)
type OfflineDiagnosticRegistryPhase uint8
const (
	OfflineDiagnosticRegistryInitial OfflineDiagnosticRegistryPhase = iota + 1
	OfflineDiagnosticRegistryFinal
	OfflineDiagnosticRegistryParentRetired
)

// All helpers below require offlineAuthorityMu held. They only copy Go scalar
// facts already observed by the existing owner; they make no host calls.
func offlineDiagnosticBeginLocked(previous OfflineRecoveryDiagnostic, op OfflineDiagnosticOperation, runtimeID, configurationID string) OfflineRecoveryDiagnostic {
	d := OfflineRecoveryDiagnostic{Version:1,DiagnosticRevision:previous.DiagnosticRevision+1,Operation:op,RuntimeID:runtimeID,ConfigurationID:configurationID,Available:true}
	if op == OfflineDiagnosticOperationUnknown || op > OfflineDiagnosticDisable || !offlineDiagnosticHex(runtimeID,20) || !offlineDiagnosticHex(configurationID,64) { d.Available = false }
	return d
}
func offlineDiagnosticFinishLocked(d *OfflineRecoveryDiagnostic, cleanupKnown bool) {
	d.LogicalReturned = true
	d.CleanupKnown = cleanupKnown && !d.uncertain && !d.Overflow
}
func offlineDiagnosticFreshDisableCoverageLocked(d *OfflineRecoveryDiagnostic) {
	// Call only at the audited typed fresh-Disable branch, which
	// cannot fall through parent register or legacy disable dispatch.
	if d.Operation != OfflineDiagnosticDisable || !d.Available || d.Overflow || d.uncertain { return }
	d.Coverage = OfflineDiagnosticCoverageComplete
	d.Update.Covered, d.Unregister.Covered, d.Register.Covered = true, true, true
	d.Status.Covered, d.DisableRecovered.Covered = true, true
}
func offlineDiagnosticNativeLocked(d *OfflineRecoveryDiagnostic, method OfflineDiagnosticMethod) *OfflineDiagnosticNative {
	switch method { case OfflineDiagnosticMethodUpdate: return &d.Update; case OfflineDiagnosticMethodUnregister: return &d.Unregister; case OfflineDiagnosticMethodRegister: return &d.Register }
	offlineDiagnosticUnknownLocked(d,OfflineDiagnosticInputRefused)
	return nil
}
func offlineDiagnosticRPCLocked(d *OfflineRecoveryDiagnostic, rpc OfflineDiagnosticRPC) *OfflineDiagnosticRPCObservation {
	switch rpc { case OfflineDiagnosticRPCStatus: return &d.Status; case OfflineDiagnosticRPCDisableRecovered: return &d.DisableRecovered }
	offlineDiagnosticUnknownLocked(d,OfflineDiagnosticInputRefused)
	return nil
}
func offlineDiagnosticBumpLocked(d *OfflineRecoveryDiagnostic, count *uint8, maximum uint8) {
	if *count >= maximum { *count = maximum; d.Overflow = true; d.Available = false; d.Coverage = OfflineDiagnosticCoverageUnknown; return }
	*count = *count + 1
}
func offlineDiagnosticUnknownLocked(d *OfflineRecoveryDiagnostic, reason OfflineDiagnosticReason) {
	d.uncertain = true
	d.Coverage = OfflineDiagnosticCoverageUnknown
	d.Update.Covered, d.Unregister.Covered, d.Register.Covered = false, false, false
	d.Status.Covered, d.DisableRecovered.Covered = false, false
	if reason <= OfflineDiagnosticNativeDispatchThrow { d.Failure = reason } else { d.Failure = OfflineDiagnosticInputRefused }
}
func offlineDiagnosticNativeCoverageLocked(d *OfflineRecoveryDiagnostic, method OfflineDiagnosticMethod, known bool) {
	if native := offlineDiagnosticNativeLocked(d,method); native != nil { native.Covered = known && !d.uncertain }
}
func offlineDiagnosticNativeReceiptLocked(d *OfflineRecoveryDiagnostic, method OfflineDiagnosticMethod, receiptKnown, issued, returned, exactReceiver bool, reason OfflineDiagnosticReason) {
	native := offlineDiagnosticNativeLocked(d,method)
	if native == nil { return }
	if !receiptKnown || returned && !issued { offlineDiagnosticUnknownLocked(d,reason); return }
	if reason != OfflineDiagnosticNone { d.Failure = reason }
	if issued {
		if native.Issued == 0 { native.ExactReceiver = exactReceiver } else { native.ExactReceiver = native.ExactReceiver && exactReceiver }
		offlineDiagnosticBumpLocked(d,&native.Issued,2)
	}
	if returned { offlineDiagnosticBumpLocked(d,&native.Returned,2) }
	if issued && !returned { offlineDiagnosticUnknownLocked(d,reason) }
}
func offlineDiagnosticNativeTerminalLocked(d *OfflineRecoveryDiagnostic, method OfflineDiagnosticMethod, outcome OfflineDiagnosticOutcome) {
	native := offlineDiagnosticNativeLocked(d,method)
	if native == nil { return }
	if outcome == OfflineDiagnosticOutcomeUnknown || outcome > OfflineDiagnosticRejected || native.Terminal >= native.Returned { offlineDiagnosticUnknownLocked(d,OfflineDiagnosticInputRefused); return }
	offlineDiagnosticBumpLocked(d,&native.Terminal,2)
	native.Outcome = outcome
}
func offlineDiagnosticRPCReceiptLocked(d *OfflineRecoveryDiagnostic, rpc OfflineDiagnosticRPC, receiptKnown, issued, returned, workerURLExact bool, reason OfflineDiagnosticReason) {
	value := offlineDiagnosticRPCLocked(d,rpc)
	if value == nil { return }
	if !receiptKnown || returned && !issued { offlineDiagnosticUnknownLocked(d,reason); return }
	if value.Issued && issued { d.Overflow = true; d.Available = false; d.Coverage = OfflineDiagnosticCoverageUnknown; return }
	value.Issued, value.Returned = issued, returned
	if issued { value.WorkerURLExact = workerURLExact }
	if reason != OfflineDiagnosticNone { d.Failure = reason }
	if issued && !returned { offlineDiagnosticUnknownLocked(d,reason) }
}
func offlineDiagnosticRPCEventLocked(d *OfflineRecoveryDiagnostic, rpc OfflineDiagnosticRPC, event OfflineDiagnosticRPCEvent) {
	value := offlineDiagnosticRPCLocked(d,rpc)
	if value == nil { return }
	switch event {
	case OfflineDiagnosticChannelCreated: offlineDiagnosticBumpLocked(d,&value.ChannelsCreated,8)
	case OfflineDiagnosticListenerAdded: offlineDiagnosticBumpLocked(d,&value.ListenerAdds,8)
	case OfflineDiagnosticListenerRemoved: offlineDiagnosticBumpLocked(d,&value.ListenerRemoves,8)
	case OfflineDiagnosticPortStarted: value.StartKnown, value.StartReturned = true, true
	case OfflineDiagnosticPort1Closed: value.Port1CloseReturned = true
	case OfflineDiagnosticPort2Closed: value.Port2CloseReturned = true
	case OfflineDiagnosticTrustedEvent: offlineDiagnosticBumpLocked(d,&value.TrustedEvents,8)
	default: offlineDiagnosticUnknownLocked(d,OfflineDiagnosticInputRefused)
	}
}
func offlineDiagnosticRPCStartContractLocked(d *OfflineRecoveryDiagnostic, rpc OfflineDiagnosticRPC, called bool) {
	if value := offlineDiagnosticRPCLocked(d,rpc); value != nil { value.StartKnown = true; if !called { value.StartReturned = false } }
}
func offlineDiagnosticRPCValidReplyLocked(d *OfflineRecoveryDiagnostic, rpc OfflineDiagnosticRPC, ack OfflineDiagnosticACK) {
	value := offlineDiagnosticRPCLocked(d,rpc)
	if value == nil { return }
	if !offlineDiagnosticACKValid(ack) { offlineDiagnosticUnknownLocked(d,OfflineDiagnosticInputRefused); return }
	if value.Terminal {
		offlineDiagnosticBumpLocked(d,&value.DuplicateTerminals,1)
		return
	}
	value.BindingExact, value.Terminal, value.ACK = true, true, ack
}
func offlineDiagnosticFrameEventLocked(d *OfflineRecoveryDiagnostic, added, known bool) {
	if !known { d.frameUncertain = true; d.Frame.BalanceKnown = false; d.CleanupKnown = false; offlineDiagnosticUnknownLocked(d,OfflineDiagnosticNativeDispatchThrow); return }
	d.Frame.BalanceKnown = !d.frameUncertain
	if added { offlineDiagnosticBumpLocked(d,&d.Frame.ListenerAdds,8) } else { offlineDiagnosticBumpLocked(d,&d.Frame.ListenerRemoves,8) }
}
func offlineDiagnosticRegistryLocked(d *OfflineRecoveryDiagnostic, phase OfflineDiagnosticRegistryPhase, known, absent bool) {
	switch phase {
	case OfflineDiagnosticRegistryInitial: d.Registry.InitialInventoryKnown = known
	case OfflineDiagnosticRegistryFinal: d.Registry.FinalInventoryKnown, d.Registry.FinalAbsent = known, known && absent
	case OfflineDiagnosticRegistryParentRetired: d.Registry.ParentPostRetirementInventoryKnown, d.Registry.ParentPostRetirementAbsent = known, known && absent
	default: offlineDiagnosticUnknownLocked(d,OfflineDiagnosticInputRefused)
	}
}
